derivation:
by
  ext x
  simpa using congrArg (fun t : Subsemiring A => x ∈ t) (Subsemiring.comap_comap (S.toSubalgebra.toSubsemiring) (g : B →+* C) (f : A →+* B))
explanation: The Subsemiring theorem gives the same composition law for the underlying carriers, using the ring-hom coercions of the star algebra homomorphisms. Extensionality transfers that equality to StarSubalgebra. The current proof instead uses Set.preimage_preimage.
